item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Lines per folio: 5; 4 on fol. 1b.
Double numbering of the folios, from 1 to 28 and from 426 to 453 (400 being represented by four "x" signs).
Proofread twice (1 zhus dag; yang zhus dag).
The name "bcom ldan ral gri" in the colophon and the title in Sanskrit and Tibetan on fol. 1b seem to have been written in color in the original. The titles are not legible on the reproduction.
A note in cursive script above the title on the cover page reads "shA n+ti pa'i dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel °° yin." Another note by the same hand below the title seems to discuss authorship (gzhung 'di °°°°°mdzad pa'i 'grel°°°) but is hardly legible.
